column1: # extractors.tsv — how to read a format and what it takes to get the tool.

# columns (TAB-separated): id <TAB> check (exit 0 = tool ready) <TAB> extract (markdown/text on STDOUT; {in} = shell-quoted input path) <TAB> install (shown to the user, NEVER run by a script) <TAB> note
# Scripts make no network calls (PRIVACY.md); installs are run by the command only after the user approves.

column5: Microsoft MarkItDown (MIT, Python 3.10+). Narrow extras on purpose: not [all] (adds audio/YouTube transcription). Keep Azure Document Intelligence / LLM options OFF - they send content off-machine

column4: See https://pandoc.org/installing.html (winget install JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc | brew install pandoc | apt install pandoc)

column3: d=$(mktemp -d) && soffice --headless --convert-to docx --outdir "$d" {in} >/dev/null 2>&1 && markitdown "$d"/*.docx; rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $rc
column4: Install LibreOffice (https://www.libreoffice.org/download/) and put soffice on PATH; also needs markitdown
column5: Legacy/ODF binary format: LibreOffice converts to docx, then MarkItDown reads it
